proposals.statement:
theorem rowStep_mod_preperiod_le (k x : ℕ) (hx : x < 2 ^ (k + 1)) :
    ∃ p > 0, ∀ t ≥ 2 * k,
      (fun r => ((4 * r) ^^^ ((2 * r) ||| r)) % 2 ^ (k + 1))^[t + p] x
        = (fun r => ((4 * r) ^^^ ((2 * r) ||| r)) % 2 ^ (k + 1))^[t] x := by
  sorry
proposals.reason: The wall is this statement at x = 1: rowNat t % 2^(k+1) is the t-th iterate of this map on 1, so a preperiod of at most 2k for that orbit is a return of the low k+1 bits of row 2k, which settles diagonal k by index k; measured true for EVERY start x at every width to 18 (524,286 starts, none failing, all periods at most 4), so it is a property of the map and admits a local proof where the seed-only wall never has.
proposals.disclaims: Strictly stronger than leftDiagonal_onset_le, not a restatement: it is about every start below 2^(k+1), and only its instance at 1 is the wall. Nobody has a proof; the per-bit growth of the transient reaches 3 for a single start, so no per-bit invariant with slope 2 exists and any proof must amortise over at least three bits.

proposals.statement:
theorem leftDiagonal_onset_le_of_rowStep_mod_preperiod
    (H : ∀ k x : ℕ, x < 2 ^ (k + 1) → ∃ p > 0, ∀ t ≥ 2 * k,
      (fun r => ((4 * r) ^^^ ((2 * r) ||| r)) % 2 ^ (k + 1))^[t + p] x
        = (fun r => ((4 * r) ^^^ ((2 * r) ||| r)) % 2 ^ (k + 1))^[t] x) :
    ∀ k, ∃ p > 0, ∃ N ≤ k, PeriodicFrom (leftDiagonal k) p N := by
  sorry
proposals.reason: This is the bridge a proof of the wall would cross once rowStep_mod_preperiod_le lands: it is proved verbatim (as leftDiagonal_onset_le_of_stepMod_preperiod, with the lambda named stepMod) in Rule30/Proofs/LeftDiagonalOnsetLe.lean as left by this attempt, via rowNat_mod_eq_iterate and the served leftDiagonal_eq_rowNat_testBit.
proposals.disclaims: Conditional on the universal preperiod statement; proves nothing about the wall on its own.
